notes.title: New Ending Structure Update!
notes.content:
[b]A major aspect of Elsinore is changing. [i]Warning: mild spoilers ahead![/i][/b]

Many of you have played and supported the game in the last 10 months, and we're enormously grateful to you all. Throughout that time, one piece of feedback has remained consistent: players don't love the way our ending system works. This is us acknowledging that we hear you, and today we're releasing a new update to Elsinore which will allow you to continue playing after choosing an ending [i]without[/i] your save file being destroyed. 

[b]Why?[/b]

When we set out to build Elsinore's final act, we knew that we wanted to capture the feeling that no matter what fate Ophelia chose for Elsinore, it was the final choice she would make. We believed most players would want to put down the game at that point and move on, so the save deletion was just our way of trying to reinforce "you can move on now." 

To our surprise (and, honestly, a bit of delight), many of you have reported that you took your ending choices quite seriously, but still wanted to see more. To peek at what might have been. It's clear that our original structure wasn't hitting our thematic goals for a large number of players. At the same time, we didn't want to abandon the notion that "endings are important decisions" entirely-- and we hope we've managed to accomplish that.

We hope that this new ending flow offers you the opportunity to do that, in its own peculiar way. 

--

[b]Other Improvements[/b]

We've also made some additional improvements and bugfixes to the game.

Additions:
- Added ability to fast-foward through credits.
- Clarified directions near the end of one lead (Irma's Ire).
- Added new expressions and VO to some scenes.

Fixes:
- Prevented a softlock happening in the docks due to a missing scene.
- Fixed various visual bugs in the UI with character portraits.
- Fixed various scene logic bugs.
- Adjusted a few scenes so they couldn't happen at weird/inappropriate times.

notes.title: 1.3.0 Patch: Alternate Costumes and Trading Cards!
notes.content:
Happy New Year! We have released version 1.3.0 with some new features. We are also incredibly honored and excited to announce that [i]Elsinore[/i] has been nominated for the [url=https://igf.com/article/here-are-your-finalists-2020-independent-games-festival-awards]2020 Independent Games Festival[/url]. The game has been nominated for Excellence in Design and Excellence in Narrative, with two additional honorable mentions.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*] Added alternate, modern costumes for 6 characters: Ophelia, Hamlet, Claudius, Gertrude, Polonius, and Laertes. These can be activated in the Gameplay Options menu.
[*] Added Steam Trading Cards. Collect them all to unlock Elsinore-themed emoji, Steam backdrops, and profile badges.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed issue where the Great Hall would be in an incorrect visual state for scenes.
[*] Fixed minor issues with various scenes.
[/list]

As always, if you experience any issues, please reach out to us on the forums or through email at hello@goldenglitch.com.

Cheers,
The Golden Glitch Team

notes.title: 1.2.0 Patch - Controller Support is Here!
notes.content:
A few exciting things have been added to Elsinore, and more updates are coming in the next couple months. As with our past updates, when you update to this patch, your game saves will be advanced to the next time loop. All progress made during your most recent loop will be preserved (just as if you hit the reset button). If you experience any issues, please reach out to us on the forums or through email at hello@goldenglitch.com.

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game should now fully support controllers across all platforms. We spent a while iterating on our controller support in the hope of giving you a fairly robust, polished experience which makes Elsinore as enjoyable to play on controller as on PC. Please feel free to leave us feedback on the discussion boards letting us know how you feel about it!
[*] We've added some additional conversations with characters for certain pieces of information.
[*] We've fixed a lot of bugs, including making the tutorial more usable and implementing solutions for a few game-breaking issues. We'll spare you the gritty details. 
[/list]

Cheers,
The Golden Glitch Team

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch is Live!
notes.content:
Our 1.0.1 hotfix build is live! Thanks to players for reporting some of these issues. If you see anything odd, you can report it to us on the forums or through email at hello@goldenglitch.com.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed keyboard movement to better align with castle geometry.
[*] Added more nuanced dialogue to several events and present scenes.
[*] Removed some redundant notifications when invited to events.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Corrected various typographical errors.
[*] Fixed various inconsistencies with events.
[*] Prevented Ophelia from sinking into stairs when talking to people.
[*] Fixed conditions for being kicked out of a certain restricted room.
[*] Prevented characters from crossing oceans to take Ophelia to events.
[*] Prevented a certain funeral from being planned multiple times.
[/list]

Cheers,
The Golden Glitch Team
